mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 8 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 9, low 6.

A court in Gjilan has ordered a one-month pre-trial detention for B. D., the suspect accused of a severe murder and illegal possession of weapons.

French health authorities have withdrawn 7 million condoms from the European market after discovering manufacturing defects that could cause tearing and increase the risk of infection and unintended pregnancy.

Bayern Munich confirmed that offensive midfielder Ismael Saibari will miss three to four months after sustaining a serious injury, a blow to the team despite the club's recent €50 million signing.

Porsche announced a shift toward ultra-luxury, limited-edition models, some priced up to $15 million, as part of a strategy to boost profitability.

The United Nations Human Development Report 2025 places Iceland at the top of the HDI rankings, while North Macedonia falls to 68th place.
